title: Channels
description: The channel server: one port per protocol for every channel, each opened only while a channel that is switched on uses it.

rtmp_port.title: RTMP port
rtmp_port.description: The port every RTMP publisher uses. Open only while a channel has RTMP on. Only one process can hold it, so run either this device or an ingest/rtmp source on it, not both.

srt_port.title: SRT port
srt_port.description: The one UDP port SRT callers use for every channel, told apart by stream id. Open only while a channel has SRT on.

webrtc_port.title: First WebRTC media port
webrtc_port.description: WHIP publishers send their media over UDP, one port each from this one up to fifteen above it, and only while one is publishing.

open_door.title: Take any RTMP publisher when there are no channels
open_door.description: How this device worked before channels: with no channel at all, the RTMP port stays open and takes anybody. Off, nothing listens until a channel needs it.

app.title: Application name
app.description: Accept publishers on this application name only. Empty accepts any, which is what makes a publisher appear with nothing configured at either end.
